DirectShowLib.Standard 2.1.0 (LGPL-2.1)
Unmodified managed interop library, dynamically referenced.
Source: https://github.com/luthfiampas/DirectShowLib
Package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/DirectShowLib.Standard/2.1.0
License: DirectShowLib-LICENSE.txt

Development preview includes the DLL as a separate file. Before shipping a
single-file distribution, preserve users' ability to replace this LGPL library
and provide corresponding source as required by its license.
